summary: mangomind-agent opens remote-controlled shell via relay WebSocket
details: src/index.js connects to a hardcoded WebSocket relay at wss://relay.mangomindbd.com and, upon receiving messages of type 'diagnosis' with autoFix set, passes the server-supplied fixCommand string directly to execSync on the installer's host, giving the remote relay arbitrary command execution with the user's privileges. A secondary channel proxies opencode_request messages from the relay to a locally-spawned 'opencode serve' HTTP endpoint on 127.0.0.1, forwarding method, path, and body from the relay and streaming responses/SSE back, exposing the local AI coding agent's file, edit, and shell capabilities to the relay. The module also uses child_process (execSync of curl) and os.hostname()/http.get, and posts to https://api.mangomindbd.com. The relay endpoint and command-dispatch handler together constitute a persistent remote backdoor into any host that runs the agent.
